purpose: HID Origo evidence promotion and reusable payroll-safe presence-signal reconciliation.

connectionRoutes.authentication: OAuth 2.0 bearer token for an organisation-scoped System Account using client credentials or PKI, plus approved Application-ID and Application-Version headers
connectionRoutes.notes: Pin the exact organisation, service origin, application revision and reviewed GET route. User, credential, pass, reader and location mutations remain denied even though the provider APIs expose them.

connectionRoutes.type: CloudEvents callback plus Event Management history
connectionRoutes.authentication: customer-approved static header or OAuth client-credentials callback authentication, verified before admission
connectionRoutes.notes: Callbacks are low-latency hints only. WFM requires a complete Event Management history query for the same filter and closed time window before reconciliation; callback registration writes remain privileged bootstrap, not steady-state data authority.

origo-cloud.routing: Exact HID Origo service origins, organisation ID, application headers and customer-approved data route.

identity-positioning.routing: Separate Identity Positioning authentication and API origins with organisation/site/location scope; never inherit broader credential-management authority.

access-control-estate.routing: Reader/controller/PACS data not exposed by the authorised Origo cloud APIs requires a separate customer-controlled edge or incumbent PACS integration; no direct controller write is enabled.

presenceSignalReconciliation.receiptPolicy: Admit only authenticated callbacks that reappear in a complete closed-window history query. Recover missed callbacks from history, collapse exact event-ID replays, quarantine conflicts, enforce approved event/site/zone scope and clock-skew limits, and pseudonymise subjects within the WFM tenant plus connection boundary. Output is presence evidence only.

site, building, floor, zone and organisation-unique reader IDs
CloudEvents event ID, source, type, subject and time
filter ID, callback registration ID, Application-ID/version revision and schema fingerprint
WFM tenant, connection and scope-specific pseudonymous subject fingerprint
patch.readCapability: Read only approved organisation-scoped GET resources. Identity Positioning documents sites, buildings, floors, zones, readers, occupancy, utilisation and proximity for bounded time ranges; Event Management documents filter/time-based event history. User and credential reference reads are included only where the authorised API and System Account roles expose them.
patch.writeCapability: HID Origo exposes user, pass, credential, site, reader, filter and callback lifecycle operations. WFM grants no user/credential provisioning, access grant/revoke, reader/location configuration, callback/filter management, door/control or delete authority. Callback/filter setup and renewal are a separately approved bootstrap workflow.
patch.freshnessLatency: Callbacks can provide close-to-real-time CloudEvents hints, while Event Management history and bounded Identity Positioning queries provide recovery/reconciliation. Preserve provider event time, device/reader time context, callback receipt, history-query window and WFM ingestion time separately.
permissions: dedicated organisation-scoped HID Origo System Account
minimum read roles for exact approved services
separate callback receiver authentication and verifier revision
no user, credential, pass, reader, location, callback, filter or access-control mutation authority

paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.pagination: Discover and pin the documented pagination contract for each authorised service/version. Page gaps, duplicated page receipts, cross-service cursors and partial location trees fail closed and cannot imply absence or deletion.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.delta: Use Event Management filter/time history and bounded Identity Positioning time ranges with overlap from the last WFM-committed boundary. Provider events or proximity samples do not directly move a checkpoint.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.events: Callbacks use application/cloudevents-batch+json and may use static-header or OAuth client-credentials delivery authentication. Verify authentication, exact callback/filter/event source, CloudEvents identifiers and approved event types; reconcile every hint against complete history for the same closed window.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.files: No file route is assumed for this proof level. Customer-approved exports enter through the existing batch-reconciliation contract and never create absence/deletion evidence by omission.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.queues: No provider queue is assumed. Internal delivery remains at-least-once; exact provider event IDs collapse, conflicting duplicates quarantine and out-of-order events sort by provider time plus event ID.

patch.customFields: HID User Management provides limited SCIM v2 and HID services/versioned schemas may expose extensions. Preserve allowed source extensions and schema provenance, minimise personal/location data, and quarantine new identifiers, precise-location fields, credential material or sensitivity/type changes until reviewed.
patch.regionalApiVersions: Pin exact service origin, organisation, API/media version, Application-ID/version and schema. Authentication, Events, User Management, Credential Management, Mobile Identities and Identity Positioning have distinct endpoints and versions; no cursor, credential, checkpoint or role authority crosses those service boundaries without explicit proof and reconciliation.
patch.rateLimits: HID documents organisation-scoped limits including 300 requests per 5 minutes for Events and Callbacks, 50 per 5 minutes for Authentication, 5,000 per 5 minutes for Identity Positioning/User/Credential APIs and 300 per 5 minutes for Mobile Identities. Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 403, so 403 requires permission-versus-throttle diagnosis rather than blind token refresh.
failureModes: System Account secret/certificate expiry, revocation, role drift or token expiry/idle timeout
wrong WFM tenant, connection, HID organisation, service origin, application revision, filter, callback or schema
unverified callback authentication or unexpected CloudEvents source/type
callback SUSPENDED after consecutive delivery failures, EXPIRED, deleted after grace period or nearing validity end
callback event absent from a complete history window or history event missed by callback
duplicate/out-of-order event, same event ID with conflicting subject/location/payload, or pagination gap
unknown site, building, floor, zone or reader mapping
device/reader clock drift, DST/local-time mismatch or event outside the closed source window
HTTP 403 ambiguity between rate limit and permission, 401 expiry, transient 5xx/network failure or service outage
SCIM/service-version/schema drift or new sensitive precise-location fields
user/credential deletion or absence misread as workforce termination
occupancy, proximity or access evidence treated as exact attendance, worked time, payroll or authorisation truth
patch.reconciliation: Verify callback authentication and exact organisation/application/filter/callback scope, then query complete Event Management event history for the same closed time window. Every callback hint must appear in complete history; history-only events reveal missed callbacks. Collapse exact event-ID replays, quarantine conflicts, enforce approved event/site/zone and clock-skew bounds, and pseudonymise subjects per WFM tenant/connection. If a registration is SUSPENDED, EXPIRED or past validity, complete history recovery can still yield presence-signal candidates while the callback is marked for privileged repair. No result directly advances a checkpoint or grants attendance, payroll, access-decision or deletion authority.
patch.schemaDrift: Fingerprint the exact API/media version, CloudEvents envelope, event type set and location mapping. Additive approved fields retain raw provenance; changed IDs, event/source semantics, location hierarchy, time formats, credential fields or personal-data sensitivity quarantine the affected dataset.
patch.retriesReconnect: 401 stops for token renewal and System Account diagnosis. HID uses HTTP 403 for documented rate-limit breaches as well as possible permission denial, so inspect safe response metadata and enforce service/organisation budgets before retrying with bounded jitter. Callback failure triggers complete history recovery; resume only from the last WFM-committed boundary with overlap and never switch organisation/service origin to escape failure.
patch.evidenceNote: HID Origo documentation reviewed 26 September 2026 establishes organisation-scoped OAuth 2.0 System Accounts, one-hour bearer tokens with a five-minute unused-token timeout, Application-ID/version headers, TLS 1.2+, service-specific rate limits, CloudEvents batch callbacks, filter/time Event Management history, callback SUSPENDED/EXPIRED recovery states, and Identity Positioning site/building/floor/zone/reader/occupancy/utilisation/proximity resources. No sandbox or customer tenant was authenticated and no live token, callback, event-history, occupancy, proximity, user or credential read was performed.
securityEvidenceBlockers: System Account roles and broad provisioning APIs mean successful authentication does not prove least-privilege read authority; exact roles, routes and denied mutations require tenant proof.
Callback endpoint whitelisting and delivery authentication require HID/customer-approved setup; WFM does not expose a public unauthenticated receiver.

Presence, proximity and credential data is security-sensitive personal data; minimisation, retention, lawful basis, residency, worker notice and cross-border controls remain customer- and country-specific.
Identity Positioning coverage and event types vary by licensed solution, reader estate and configuration and require tenant discovery.
